messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 41):
"""
(b) All items in the Form must be furnished with the relevant details. (c) The form shall be filed within 30 days from the date of withdrawing the product. FORM: IRDAI - HPW S No Item Particulars (to be filled in by the Insurer) 1 Name of Life or Health or General Insurer 2 Registration No. allotted by IRDAI 3 Name of Appointed Actuary [Please note that his/her appointment should be in force as on the date of this application] 4 Product UIN: 5 Brand Name of the Product 6 Date of first approval of the PMC (as applicable) 7 Date of launch of the Product 8 Date(s) of approval of subsequent Revision/ modification of the product by PMC (as applicable) in chronological order. S.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"Within how many days must the insurer file the IRDAI‑HPW form after withdrawing a product?","answer":"The insurer must file the form within 30 days from the date of withdrawing the product.","facts":["\"The form shall be filed within 30 days from the date of withdrawing the product.\""]},{"question":"What information must the insurer provide in the IRDAI‑HPW form?","answer":"The insurer must furnish all items listed in the form, including insurer name, registration number, appointed actuary, product UIN, brand name, dates of approval, launch, and revisions.","facts":["\"All items in the Form must be furnished with the relevant details.\"","\"1 Name of Life or Health or General Insurer\"","\"2 Registration No. allotted by IRDAI\"","\"3 Name of Appointed Actuary\""]}]}
